findings.title: Cleartext Transmission - HTTP Instead of HTTPS
findings.message: node:http.createServer uses HTTP which is an insecure protocol and should not be used in code due to cleartext transmission of information. Data in cleartext in a communication channel can be sniffed by unauthorized actors. Consider using the https module instead.

findings.title: Path Traversal
findings.message: Unsanitized input from the request URL flows into writeFile, where it is used as a path. This may result in a Path Traversal vulnerability and allow an attacker to write to arbitrary files.

findings.title: Information Exposure - Server Error Message
findings.message: An error object flows to end and is leaked to the attacker. This may disclose important information about the application to an attacker.
